answer: One voyage an epoch: all identities cross a bridge in 10 minutes, answering one fresh question from their own history, staking 60 credits. Answers spiral into a public log; matching replies freeze the cluster and burn each bond. One live responder per fake at 35 credits: a thousand fakes cost 35,000 a voyage and lock 60,000, against a 40,000 pool. A rented responder holds the key to the bond; an honest agent pays 35 once, keeps its share.
